plugins.name: anchor
plugins.description: Consistency across the code-change lifecycle: issue, change request, review, release.

plugins.name: beacon
plugins.description: At-a-glance awareness across concurrent Claude Code sessions — a terminal-agnostic fleet dashboard plus iTerm2 per-pane painting.

plugins.name: ClaudeWatch
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that screens shell commands and the code Claude writes to disk for safety, via 'claude-watchdog'

plugins.name: cleat
plugins.description: Keep a repo's agent instructions in one AGENTS.md that every tool reads, with CLAUDE.md reduced to a pointer at it.

plugins.name: sextant
plugins.description: AI-assisted, best-effort SPEC-driven development — keep requirements in source control, track how the code covers them, reconcile the two either direction.

plugins.name: shipshape
plugins.description: Know what's changing in your Claude Code harness and keep it current — every Claude Code upgrade handled, every plugin reconciled, updated, and pruned.

plugins.name: tack
plugins.description: Route tracker for AI-assisted development work — pivots, deliverables, and dependencies — across session boundaries
